mechanism_narrative: Accelerating decline in RETAIL_REC over the past four weeks (from -16.1% to -29.1%) reflects a self-reinforcing contraction in consumer mobility. This momentum persists over the next four weeks, driving RETAIL_REC further negative as the baseline effect compounds.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC declined 13 percentage points over four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than the mean of the last 28 days, or shows reversal to positive growth.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated RESIDENTIAL mobility (13.7% at t-0w, up from 7.0% at t-3w) indicates sustained shelter-in-place behavior. This behavioral lock-in suppresses discretionary retail visits over the next four weeks as consumers remain home-bound despite any marginal policy relaxation.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL rose 6.7 percentage points over four weeks
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL mobility falls below 10 percent change while RETAIL_REC simultaneously rises above the prior 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT station mobility has collapsed 11.9 percentage points (from -15.1% to -27.0%) over four weeks. This severe transit contraction signals either supply-side closure or demand-side avoidance. Either mechanism will suppress RETAIL_REC recovery over the next four weeks, as retail footfall depends on transit access.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls more than 10 percentage points week-on-week
failure_condition: TRANSIT mobility stabilizes or rebounds above -20 percent while RETAIL_REC remains below -25 percent over the next 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM mobility remains elevated (19.4% at t-0w) despite declining from 26.1%, indicating sustained essential-goods demand. This essential-mobility floor creates a substitution effect: consumers consolidate trips to essential retail, reducing discretionary RETAIL_REC visits over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM remains above 15 percent while RETAIL_REC falls below -25 percent
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above -20 percent over the next 28 days while GROCERY_PHARM remains above 15 percent, contradicting substitution logic.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES mobility has deteriorated sharply (from -5.3% to -19.9% over four weeks), signaling widespread remote work adoption or layoffs. This employment contraction reduces household purchasing power and discretionary spending, suppressing RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES declined 14.6 percentage points over four weeks
failure_condition: WORKPLACES rebounds above -10 percent within two weeks while RETAIL_REC simultaneously rises above the prior 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: The synchronized collapse across TRANSIT (-27.0%), WORKPLACES (-19.9%), and RETAIL_REC (-29.1%) at t-0w indicates a coordinated policy shock (e.g., lockdown tightening). Recovery requires simultaneous reversal across all three domains. Absent coordinated reopening signals, RETAIL_REC will remain depressed over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: all three series fall below -20 percent simultaneously
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above -15 percent over the next 28 days without corresponding rises in both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES above -15 percent.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS mobility has declined consistently (from -18.0% to -23.7%) over four weeks, indicating suppressed outdoor recreation. This outdoor-activity contraction reflects seasonal or policy-driven constraints that also suppress retail-adjacent outdoor shopping. RETAIL_REC will remain depressed as long as PARKS mobility stays below -20 percent.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS declined 5.7 percentage points over four weeks
failure_condition: PARKS mobility rebounds above -15 percent within two weeks while RETAIL_REC remains below -25 percent.

mechanism_narrative: The divergence between RESIDENTIAL elevation (13.7%) and RETAIL_REC depression (-29.1%) at t-0w reflects a behavioral regime shift toward home-centric consumption. This regime persists if RESIDENTIAL remains elevated and WORKPLACES remains depressed, jointly suppressing RETAIL_REC recovery over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL above 12 percent AND WORKPLACES below -15 percent
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above -20 percent over the next 28 days while both RESIDENTIAL remains above 12 percent and WORKPLACES remains below -15 percent.
